"Entered according to Act of Congress A.D. 1876 by F.W. Beer & Co. in the Office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington." Includes business directories, distance table, statistical table of U.S., principle governments of the world, insets of Alma, St. Louis, Estella, Elm Hall, Riverdale, Bridgeville, Pompeh, diagram of Gratiot County, Ithaca, Breckenridge, views of public, residential, and commercial properties. LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into 6 panels to enable folding. LC Land ownership maps, 329 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
